cards.text: Joshua, Israel's leader, and the Israelites have conquered thirty-one kings west of the Jordan (Joshua 12:7, 24). Now Joshua is old and well along in years. And the LORD speaks to him.

cards.question: Joshua is old, and the LORD speaks to him about the land. What does He say?

answers.text: Very much of the land remains to be possessed
All of the land has now been possessed
The land must wait for a new leader

cards.text: Then the LORD lists what's left: the land of the Philistines and their five rulers, the land of the Canaanites, the Gebalites, and all Lebanon. That's me sealing one cookie box, feeling proud, and turning around to a whole WALL of empty ones.

cards.question: The LORD says the people of the hill country, all the Sidonians, will be driven out before the Israelites. Who does He say will drive them out?

answers.text: The tribes east of the Jordan

cards.question: Not all the land is taken yet. True or false: the LORD tells Joshua to be sure to divide it by lot as an inheritance to Israel.
The LORD tells Joshua to divide this land as an inheritance. Who is it for?

answers.text: Nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh
The tribes of Reuben and Gad

cards.text: Reuben, Gad and the other half of Manasseh aren't in this split. They'd already received land east of the Jordan from Moses, the servant of the LORD: keys in hand before anybody else even toured the house.

Their land stretches from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley through Gilead and all Bashan, taking in the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites and the whole kingdom of Og in Bashan. Moses had struck them down and dispossessed them.

cards.question: The Geshurites and the Maacathites are two peoples living in that eastern land. True or false: the Israelites drove the Geshurites and the Maacathites out.

cards.text: Then there's the tribe of Levi, the tribe the LORD set apart to serve Him (Deuteronomy 10:8). Moses had given them no inheritance.

cards.question: Levi, the tribe set apart to serve the LORD, gets no inheritance of land from Moses. What is Levi's inheritance instead?

answers.text: The food offerings to the LORD

cards.text: Then the text spells out what Moses had given each eastern tribe on the plains of Moab: Reuben's clans get Sihon's old plateau, Gad's clans get the cities of Gilead, and the half-tribe of Manasseh gets Og's Bashan, including all the towns of Jair. Tucked into Reuben's list is a surprise: the Israelites also killed the diviner Balaam son of Beor. And it closes on Levi one more time. The LORD, the God of Israel, is their inheritance.
